description: sfxnz's TensorFold Python 0.6.6 fork at 19f5478b adds the DeepSeek V4.1 CUDA family and measured decode optimizations; the newer native TensorFold engine does not support this family. EXL3 2bpw MCG/Viterbi experts with the checkpoint's FP8/MXFP8 dense weights and built-in DSpark drafting. Four streams, native 1,048,576-token window, decode-share 0.5 and up to five drafts with confidence 0.15. Thinking is off by default. Text only. The 105 GiB per-node peak is a conservative estimate from the creator's memory observations; physical execution remains unmeasured here.
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash EXL3 TensorFold dual Spark (sfxnz)
